title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 18: Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahab, Micaiah's warning, and the battle at Ramoth Gilead.

questions.text: With whom did Jehoshaphat ally himself at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:1 says Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance and allied himself with Ahab.

answers.text: Ahab
Hiram king of Tyre
Jeroboam
Pharaoh king of Egypt

questions.text: Where did Ahab persuade Jehoshaphat to go up with him to war?
questions.explanation: Ahab moved Jehoshaphat to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead, and Jehoshaphat said, "We will be with you in the war."

answers.text: Jerusalem
Damascus
Ramoth Gilead
Beth Shemesh

questions.text: Why did the king of Israel say he hated Micaiah the son of Imla?
questions.explanation: The king of Israel said he hated Micaiah because he never prophesied good concerning him, but always evil.

answers.text: He refused to come when the king called him
He never prophesied good about him, only evil
He served the gods of the Syrians
He had insulted the queen in public

questions.text: What did Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah make for himself?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah made himself horns of iron and said, "Yahweh says, 'With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.'"

answers.text: A bronze serpent
A golden calf
A crown of silver
Horns of iron

questions.text: How did Micaiah say he saw all Israel?
questions.explanation: Micaiah said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd."

answers.text: Scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd
Feasting in the gate of Samaria
Marching victoriously into Ramoth Gilead
Bowing down before the Syrians in Damascus

questions.text: In Micaiah's vision, what did the spirit say it would be in order to entice Ahab?
questions.explanation: The spirit said, "I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets."

answers.text: A great storm on the road to the battle
A lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
A dream that would trouble him at night
A messenger from the king of Syria

questions.text: What did Zedekiah do to Micaiah after his prophecy?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek.

answers.text: He threw him into a pit
He tore his robe
He bound him with chains
He struck him on the cheek

questions.text: What did the king of Israel order Micaiah to be fed in prison?
questions.explanation: The king said to put Micaiah in prison and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction until he returned in peace.

answers.text: Only figs and dried raisins
Meat from the king's own table
Bread and water of affliction
Nothing at all until he returned

questions.text: What did the king of Israel do before going into the battle?
questions.explanation: The king of Israel told Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes," and he disguised himself.

answers.text: He offered a sacrifice to Yahweh
He disguised himself
He sent his army home
He gave his crown to Jehoshaphat

questions.text: How was the king of Israel wounded in the battle?
questions.explanation: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor.

answers.text: A stone from a sling hit him on his forehead
His chariot overturned on a steep hill near the city
A Syrian captain pierced him with a spear
A random arrow struck him between the joints of the armor
